Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6518 of 2023

Applicant :- Ravi Chaudhary
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Saurabh Shahi,Abhilasha Singh,Ashutosh Yadav,Pradeepta Kumar Sh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
IInd supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant, is taken on record.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Ravi Chaudhary with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.962 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B I.P.C. & Section 66-D Information Technology Act, P.S. Civil Lines, District Moradabad during pendency of the trial.
3. Allegation in the FIR is that on secret information from informer that certain persons are engaged in online fraud in second floor of Hair and Care Building at Hailat Road.

Informant and his team raided the premises and found that three boys and fourteen girls are indulged in work at laptops and computers and talking on mobile and on enquiry it was found that applicant was disclosed as owner Ravi Chaudhary vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71954111/

entities.text: owner Ravi Chaudhary vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 of the office and his main associates are co-accused Aniket Gautam, Ravi Kumar and Swati Gautam and rest girls are said to have been employed at monthly wages of Rs.8,000/- and had no concerned about the work of the aforesaid persons.
It is also alleged in the FIR that from the office of the applicant and other co-accused persons various electronic devices have been recovered.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Applicant also runs insurance business, which is registered under UDYAM, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise since 24.09.2021.

entities.text: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He next submitted that no complaint whatsoever has been lodged against the applicant for cheating the persons and investigating officer has not collected any evidence during investigation regarding cheating and money taken from any individual on the pretext of getting him sanctioned any loan against the applicant.
No evidence in support of the allegation that applicant has eveR used any forged document as genuine to cheat anybody as no offence under alleged sections are made out.

Learned counsel for the applicant next submitted that co-accused Ravi Kumar, Swati Gautam has been granted bail by the court below vide orders dated 04.01.2023 and co-accused Talewar Singh has been granted bail by coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 28.03.2023.
Learned counsel for the applicant next submits that the applicant having better case for getting bail on account of parity.
Applicant has criminal history, which has been explained in Para-3 of the IInd supplementary affidavit.
Charge-sheet has been submitted.
There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 16.11.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Ravi Chaudhary, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
